detail.body:
# PR type

- [x] Bug Fix
- [ ] New Feature
- [ ] Document Updates
- [ ] More Models or Datasets Support

# PR information

Legacy MCore can omit expert gradients or overcount TP replicas when computing the gradient norm, changing gradient clipping. With EP=1 and ETP!=TP, expert gradients can also use the wrong DP group and cause expert replicas to diverge.

This PR backports:

- [Megatron-LM#5916](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/5916) (MCore 0.19): use ETP for expert duplicate filtering, preserve `allreduce` on FP32 main parameters, fix expert DP routing before DDP wrapping, and restore expert shard metadata for GPU TE and MindSpeed linear layers. Column weights/biases and row weights are shards; row biases are replicas.
- [Megatron-LM#3213](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/3213) (MCore 0.17): count ordinary `duplicated` TE parameters once.
- Native TP metadata repair for embedding/column/row weights when checkpoint loading skips initialization, preserving partition dimensions and stride.

The patches in `swift/megatron/init.py` are idempotent and reapplied after MindSpeed repatching. Filtering is capability-gated; metadata fixes apply below their respective upstream versions.

Related: [mcore-bridge#229](https://github.com/modelscope/mcore-bridge/issues/229), [mcore-bridge#231](https://github.com/modelscope/mcore-bridge/pull/231).

## Validation

**Compatibility tests:** MCore 0.16.0: 14 passed in both GPU and NPU environments. Official 0.19 source: 12 passed, two legacy-only tests skipped. Repository pre-commit checks passed.

### H20: 300-step comparison with upstream MCore

Compared unpatched MCore 0.16.0, MCore 0.16.0 plus this PR, and official [`core_v0.19.0` source](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/tree/core_v0.19.0) (reports version 0.19.1 and uses native fixes).

All variants shared the H20-3e container, PyTorch 2.9.0+cu130, TE 2.9.0 and mcore-bridge snapshot; the upstream comparison switched MCore source in that environment.

- Model/data: Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, **two layers**, full embedding/output and all 128 experts; `alpaca-gpt4-data-zh`, first 512 records.
- Training: BF16 full parameters, 300 optimizer steps per variant/topology, micro/global batch=1/8, length=128, seed/data_seed=42, PP=CP=1, SP enabled, grouped GEMM/alltoall, distributed AdamW, LR=1e-5, clip=1, full recomputation and unfused attention.
- Initial parameter and all actual input/label hashes matched across corresponding ranks. All runs completed 300 updates with finite loss/norm and exit code 0. The two-device patched/upstream pair used separate H20 pairs; others used the same devices sequentially.

Loss MAE compares matching optimizer steps:

| TP / EP / ETP | Unpatched vs upstream | Backport vs upstream | MAE reduction |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 2 / 1 / 2 | 0.00844809 | 0.00213341 | 3.96x |
| 4 / 1 / 2 | 0.45497113 | 0.00229694 | 198.08x |
| 2 / 2 / 2 | 0.00823119 | 0.00238547 | 3.45x |
| 2 / 4 / 1 | 0.00850320 | 0.00223996 | 3.80x |

The independent norm reference uses module layouts and optimizer gradient shards, not the repaired TP flags:

- Three unpatched cases had maximum norm errors of 16.8–17.4%, with actual post-clipping norms reaching 1.202–1.211 for a threshold of 1. Backport/upstream norm errors were below 2.6e-7 and post-clipping errors below 6.6e-7.
- For `(TP,EP,ETP)=(4,1,2)`, wrong DP routing caused expert replica weight differences up to 0.0009765625 at sampled positions; both repaired variants had zero sampled spread. A reference norm is not reported for the incorrectly synchronized baseline.

TE 2.9.0 already marks expert shards here. The other three baselines expose missing embedding/output TP metadata, so the improvements cover the combined fixes, not solely expert filtering.

### Ascend 910B3: independent norm and clipping checks

Before/after BF16 training with reduced-layer Qwen3 MoE, all 128 experts, MCore 0.16.0 and ETP=1 produced:

| Training | Original norm relative error | Patched max error | Original actual norm after clipping |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Full parameters | 5.785–10.128% | 1.675e-7 | 1.061403–1.112694 |
| LoRA | 25.105–27.618% | 1.287e-7 | 1.335198–1.381556 |

With clip=1, patched actual norms were approximately 1; initial parameter and input/label hashes matched.

Three-step ETP=2 full-parameter checks covered `(2,1,2),(4,1,2),(2,2,2)` on H20 and Ascend/MindSpeed. Patched norm errors were below 1.1e-7 on GPU and 1.6e-7 on NPU, with finite gradients and actual updates.

On NPU `(2,1,2)`, adding expert shard metadata to the earlier backport reduced the norm error from 1.0222% to 5.830e-8 and restored post-clipping norms from 1.00754–1.01033 to approximately 1. GPU TE already supplied these flags.

### Full 48-layer LoRA: 200-step GPU/NPU comparison

Four H20-3e GPUs and four Ascend 910B3 NPUs each completed 200 LoRA steps on full BF16 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 and `alpaca-gpt4-data-zh`.

Configuration: MCore 0.16.0, TP=2/EP=4/ETP=1, PP=CP=1, micro/global batch=4/8, length=128, LoRA rank/alpha=8/16, dropout=0, LR=1e-5 and clip=1. Effective targets were explicitly matched: `linear_qkv`, `linear_fc1`, `linear_fc2`; the separate NPU `all-linear` discovery issue is outside this PR.

Weights, tokenizer, data, initial parameters and all actual input/label hashes matched. **Loss MAE: 0.00519383; maximum absolute difference: 0.03110123.**

### Scope

Cross-version MAE includes other MCore changes; deterministic execution and repeated-run noise were not controlled. The 300-step model has two layers and repeats 512 records; the three-step runs only check correctness. These results do not establish bitwise or downstream-quality equivalence. High-version MCore was tested on GPU only. Expert LoRA remains limited to ETP=1. FP8, arbitrary custom process groups, checkpoint save/resume and performance were not validated.

# Checklist

- [x] I have linked the related issue above, if there is one.
- [ ] I have reviewed and understand every changed line, and I can explain how the change works and why it is correct.
- [x] I have run the relevant tests or reproductions locally, and included the commands and results above (if applicable).
- [ ] I am responsible for the content of this PR, regardless of how it was produced.

 logger = get_logger()
 
 
+def _legacy_expert_topology():
+    import megatron.core
+
+    return version.parse(megatron.core.__version__) < version.parse('0.19.0')
+
+
+def _patch_uninitialized_tp_weight(layer, partition_dim):
+    # Additional legacy compatibility: perform_initialization=False skips native TP
+    # weight metadata. Restore it so gradient statistics count every independent shard.
+    original = layer.__init__
+    if getattr(original, '_swift_tp_metadata', False):
+        return
+    signature = inspect.signature(original)
+
+    @wraps(original)
+    def init(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        original(self, *args, **kwargs)
+        weight = getattr(self, 'weight', None)
+        if weight is not None and not hasattr(weight, 'tensor_model_parallel'):
+            from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.layers import set_tensor_model_parallel_attributes
+
+            # Checkpoint loading skips initialization, but these weights are still
+            # independent TP shards. Preserve the constructor's stride (e.g. GLU=2).
+            stride = signature.bind(self, *args, **kwargs).arguments.get('stride', 1)
+            set_tensor_model_parallel_attributes(weight, True, partition_dim, stride)
+
+    init._swift_tp_metadata = True
+    layer.__init__ = init
+
+
+def _patch_duplicated_te_parameters(layer):
+    # Backport the duplicated-parameter metadata fix from MCore 0.17.0:
+    # https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/3213
+    # Ordinary LoRA TP replicas must be counted once, rather than as independent shards.
+    original = layer.__init__
+    if getattr(original, '_swift_duplicated_metadata', False):
+        return
+    signature = inspect.signature(original)
+
+    @wraps(original)
+    def init(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        original(self, *args, **kwargs)
+        arguments = signature.bind(self, *args, **kwargs).arguments
+        if arguments.get('parallel_mode') == 'duplicated' and not arguments.get('is_expert', False):
+            # TE only sees a local linear; MCore knows these are ordinary TP replicas.
+            for param in self.parameters():
+                param.tensor_model_parallel = False
+
+    init._swift_duplicated_metadata = True
+    layer.__init__ = init
+
+
+def _set_expert_parameter_attributes(module, parallel_mode, use_expert_pgs):
+    # https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/5916 (MCore 0.19.0).
+    # Only direct weights/biases carry this layer's partitioning; nested adapters
+    # have their own shard/replica layout. Row biases remain ETP replicas.
+    for name, param in module.named_parameters(recurse=False):
+        param.allreduce = not use_expert_pgs
+        match = re.fullmatch(r'(weight|bias)\d*', name)
+        kind = match.group(1) if match else None
+        is_partitioned = parallel_mode in ('column', 'row') and (kind == 'weight' or
+                                                                 (parallel_mode == 'column' and kind == 'bias'))
+        if kind in ('weight', 'bias'):
+            param.tensor_model_parallel = is_partitioned
+        if is_partitioned:
+            param.partition_dim = 1 if parallel_mode == 'row' else 0
+            param.partition_stride = 1
+
+
+def _patch_te_expert_parameters(layer, parallel_mode=None):
+    original = layer.__init__
+    if getattr(original, '_swift_te_expert_metadata', False):
+        return
+    signature = inspect.signature(original)
+
+    @wraps(original)
+    def init(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        arguments = signature.bind(self, *args, **kwargs)
+        arguments.apply_defaults()
+        arguments = arguments.arguments
+        original(self, *args, **kwargs)
+        if not arguments.get('is_expert', False):
+            return
+        config = self.config
+        etp = config.expert_tensor_parallel_size or config.tensor_model_parallel_size
+        use_expert_pgs = config.expert_model_parallel_size > 1 or etp != config.tensor_model_parallel_size
+        # Explicit expert communication clears TE's internal parallel_mode. Use
+        # the constructor input, including when the layer does not store is_expert.
+        _set_expert_parameter_attributes(self, arguments.get('parallel_mode', parallel_mode), use_expert_pgs)
+        if 'stride' in arguments:
+            for param in self.parameters(recurse=False):
+                if getattr(param, 'tensor_model_parallel', False):
+                    param.partition_stride = arguments['stride']
+
+    init._swift_te_expert_metadata = True
+    layer.__init__ = init
+
+
+def patch_megatron_compatibility():
+    import megatron.core
+    from megatron.core import parallel_state, tensor_parallel
+    from megatron.core.tensor_parallel import layers
+
+    # Backport expert gradient-statistics filtering from MCore 0.19.0:
+    # https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/5916
+    # Expert replicas are identified by ETP, which can differ from ordinary TP.
+    original_filter = layers.param_is_not_tensor_parallel_duplicate
+    if 'expert_tp_group' not in inspect.signature(original_filter).parameters:
+
+        def param_is_not_tensor_parallel_duplicate(param, tp_group=None, expert_tp_group=None):
+            """Return True when this rank's parameter contributes to gradient statistics.
+
+            param carries shard/topology metadata; tp_group and expert_tp_group identify
+            ordinary/expert tensor replicas. False excludes a duplicate from statistics only.
+            """
+            # Independent shards all contribute; replicas are counted on one TP/ETP rank.
+            if getattr(param, 'tensor_model_parallel', False):
+                return True
+            if not getattr(param, 'allreduce', True):
+                if expert_tp_group is None:
+                    expert_tp_group = parallel_state.get_expert_tensor_parallel_group()
+                tp_group = expert_tp_group
+            rank = tp_group.rank() if tp_group is not None else parallel_state.get_tensor_model_parallel_rank()
+            return rank == 0
+
+        # Some callers imported the function before Swift initialized Megatron.
+        for name, module in tuple(sys.modules.items()):
+            if module is None or not name.startswith(('megatron.', 'mindspeed.')):
+                continue
+            if getattr(module, 'param_is_not_tensor_parallel_duplicate', None) is original_filter:
+                module.param_is_not_tensor_parallel_duplicate = param_is_not_tensor_parallel_duplicate
+        logger.info('Backported Megatron expert TP gradient-statistics filtering (#5916).')
+
+    if not _legacy_expert_topology():
+        return
+    from megatron.core.extensions import transformer_engine as te
+
+    if version.parse(megatron.core.__version__) < version.parse('0.17.0'):
+        _patch_duplicated_te_parameters(te.TELinear)
+    _patch_te_expert_parameters(te.TELinear)
+    _patch_te_expert_parameters(te.TEGroupedLinear)
+    # GPU Column/Row inherit TELinear; MindSpeed may replace them with independent
+    # classes or native Megatron layers. Preserve native metadata/stride handling.
+    for layer, mode in ((te.TEColumnParallelLinear, 'column'), (te.TERowParallelLinear, 'row')):
+        if not issubclass(layer, (te.TELinear, layers.ColumnParallelLinear, layers.RowParallelLinear)):
+            _patch_te_expert_parameters(layer, mode)
+    native_layers = (
+        (layers.VocabParallelEmbedding, 0),
+        (layers.ColumnParallelLinear, 0),
+        (layers.RowParallelLinear, 1),
+    )
+    for layer, dim in native_layers:
+        _patch_uninitialized_tp_weight(layer, dim)
+    # #5916 also preserves optimizer parameter metadata. Legacy MCore copies TP
+    # attributes here when creating FP32 main parameters; carry allreduce as well
+    # so those parameters retain the expert topology used by the filter above.
+    original_copy = layers.copy_tensor_model_parallel_attributes
+    if getattr(original_copy, '_swift_expert_metadata', False):
+        return
+
+    @wraps(original_copy)
+    def copy_tensor_model_parallel_attributes(destination_tensor, source_tensor):
+        original_copy(destination_tensor, source_tensor)
+        if hasattr(source_tensor, 'allreduce'):
+            destination_tensor.allreduce = source_tensor.allreduce
+
+    copy_tensor_model_parallel_attributes._swift_expert_metadata = True
+    layers.copy_tensor_model_parallel_attributes = copy_tensor_model_parallel_attributes
+    tensor_parallel.copy_tensor_model_parallel_attributes = copy_tensor_model_parallel_attributes
+
+
+def prepare_expert_parallel_parameters(model):
+    # Backport #5916's expert DP routing rule (MCore 0.19.0), before DDP builds buckets:
+    # https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/5916
+    # Apply it by expert ownership to cover both backend implementations and LoRA.
+    if not _legacy_expert_topology():
+        return
+    from megatron.core.transformer.moe.moe_layer import BaseMoELayer
+
+    for module in model.modules():
+        if not isinstance(module, BaseMoELayer) or module.experts is None:
+            continue
+        config = module.config
+        etp = config.expert_tensor_parallel_size or config.tensor_model_parallel_size
+        use_expert_groups = config.expert_model_parallel_size > 1 or etp != config.tensor_model_parallel_size
+        # Expert ownership works for GPU TE, MindSpeed and native expert implementations,
+        # including adapters. Router/shared-expert params belong to ordinary TP/DP.
+        # Legacy constructors only check EP, missing EP=1 with ETP different from TP.
+        for param in module.experts.parameters():
+            param.allreduce = not use_expert_groups
+
+

+# Copyright (c) ModelScope Contributors. All rights reserved.
+import torch
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+
+class RankGroup:
+
+    def __init__(self, rank):
+        self._rank = rank
+
+    def rank(self):
+        return self._rank
+
+    def size(self):
+        return 2
+
+
+class TestExpertParallelCompat(unittest.TestCase):
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        from swift.megatron import init
+        cls.compat = init
+
+    def test_expert_filter_keeps_distinct_experts_and_deduplicates_replicas(self):
+        from megatron.core import tensor_parallel
+
+        predicate = tensor_parallel.param_is_not_tensor_parallel_duplicate
+        expert = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(1))
+        expert.allreduce = False
+        dense = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(1))
+        self.assertTrue(predicate(expert, tp_group=RankGroup(1), expert_tp_group=RankGroup(0)))
+        self.assertFalse(predicate(dense, tp_group=RankGroup(1), expert_tp_group=RankGroup(0)))
+        self.assertTrue(predicate(dense, tp_group=RankGroup(0), expert_tp_group=RankGroup(1)))
+        self.assertFalse(predicate(expert, tp_group=RankGroup(0), expert_tp_group=RankGroup(1)))
+        expert.tensor_model_parallel = True
+        self.assertTrue(predicate(expert, tp_group=RankGroup(1), expert_tp_group=RankGroup(1)))
+
+    def test_legacy_expert_filter_uses_global_etp_group(self):
+        if not self.compat._legacy_expert_topology():
+            self.skipTest('Native MCore callers pass the expert TP group explicitly.')
+        from megatron.core import parallel_state, tensor_parallel
+
+        expert = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(1))
+        expert.allreduce = False
+        predicate = tensor_parallel.param_is_not_tensor_parallel_duplicate
+        for rank in (0, 1):
+            with self.subTest(expert_tp_rank=rank), \
+                    patch.object(parallel_state, 'get_expert_tensor_parallel_group', return_value=RankGroup(rank)):
+                self.assertEqual(predicate(expert, tp_group=RankGroup(1 - rank)), rank == 0)
+
+    def test_norm_includes_both_independent_experts(self):
+        from megatron.core import tensor_parallel
+
+        params = [torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(1)) for _ in range(2)]
+        for p, grad in zip(params, (3., 4.)):
+            p.allreduce = False
+            p.grad = torch.tensor([grad])
+        predicate = tensor_parallel.param_is_not_tensor_parallel_duplicate
+        selected = [
+            p.grad for rank, p in enumerate(params)
+            if predicate(p, tp_group=RankGroup(rank), expert_tp_group=RankGroup(0))
+        ]
+        norm = torch.stack([g.square().sum() for g in selected]).sum().sqrt()
+        self.assertEqual(norm.item(), 5.)
+        for p in params:
+            p.grad.mul_(1. / norm)
+        actual = torch.stack([p.grad.square().sum() for p in params]).sum().sqrt()
+        self.assertAlmostEqual(actual.item(), 1., places=6)
+
+    def test_legacy_main_param_copies_expert_metadata(self):
+        if not self.compat._legacy_expert_topology():
+            self.skipTest('Native MCore copies optimizer metadata with a separate helper.')
+        from megatron.core import tensor_parallel
+
+        model_param = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(2, 2))
+        model_param.allreduce = False
+        model_param.tensor_model_parallel = True
+        model_param.partition_dim = 0
+        model_param.partition_stride = 1
+        main_param = model_param.detach().reshape(-1).clone()
+        tensor_parallel.copy_tensor_model_parallel_attributes(main_param, model_param)
+        self.assertIs(main_param.allreduce, False)
+        self.assertIs(main_param.tensor_model_parallel, True)
+        self.assertEqual(main_param.partition_dim, 0)
+
+    def test_uninitialized_native_tp_weights_keep_all_shards(self):
+        from megatron.core import ModelParallelConfig, tensor_parallel
+        from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.layers import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear, VocabParallelEmbedding
+
+        config = ModelParallelConfig(
+            tensor_model_parallel_size=2, use_cpu_initialization=True, perform_initialization=False)
+        group = RankGroup(1)
+        column = ColumnParallelLinear(4, 8, config=config, init_method=None, bias=True, stride=2, tp_group=group)
+        row = RowParallelLinear(
+            4,
+            8,
+            config=config,
+            init_method=None,
+            bias=True,
+            input_is_parallel=True,
+            skip_bias_add=True,
+            tp_group=group)
+        embedding = VocabParallelEmbedding(8, 4, config=config, init_method=None, tp_group=group)
+        model = torch.nn.ModuleList([embedding, column, row])
+        self.compat.prepare_expert_parallel_parameters(model)
+        predicate = tensor_parallel.param_is_not_tensor_parallel_duplicate
+        for module, dim in ((embedding, 0), (column, 0), (row, 1)):
+            self.assertTrue(predicate(module.weight, tp_group=group))
+            self.assertEqual(module.weight.partition_dim, dim)
+            self.assertEqual(module.weight.partition_stride, 2 if module is column else 1)
+        self.assertTrue(predicate(column.bias, tp_group=group))
+        self.assertFalse(predicate(row.bias, tp_group=group))
+        self.compat.prepare_expert_parallel_parameters(model)
+        self.assertEqual(row.weight.partition_dim, 1)
+
+    def test_duplicated_te_parameters_are_replicas(self):
+        from megatron.core import tensor_parallel
+
+        class LocalLinear(torch.nn.Module):
+
+            def __init__(self, parallel_mode, is_expert=False):
+                super().__init__()
+                self.weight = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(2, 2))
+                self.weight.tensor_model_parallel = True
+
+        self.compat._patch_duplicated_te_parameters(LocalLinear)
+        constructor = LocalLinear.__init__
+        self.compat._patch_duplicated_te_parameters(LocalLinear)
+        self.assertIs(LocalLinear.__init__, constructor)
+        duplicate = LocalLinear('duplicated')
+        self.assertIs(duplicate.weight.tensor_model_parallel, False)
+        predicate = tensor_parallel.param_is_not_tensor_parallel_duplicate
+        self.assertTrue(predicate(duplicate.weight, tp_group=RankGroup(0)))
+        self.assertFalse(predicate(duplicate.weight, tp_group=RankGroup(1)))
+        self.assertIs(LocalLinear('column').weight.tensor_model_parallel, True)
+        self.assertIs(LocalLinear('duplicated', is_expert=True).weight.tensor_model_parallel, True)
+
+    def test_te_expert_metadata_distinguishes_shards_and_replicas(self):
+        for mode in ('column', 'row', None):
+            for use_expert_pgs in (False, True):
+                with self.subTest(mode=mode, use_expert_pgs=use_expert_pgs):
+                    module = torch.nn.Module()

+                self.bias = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(2))
+
+        config = SimpleNamespace(
+            tensor_model_parallel_size=4, expert_model_parallel_size=1, expert_tensor_parallel_size=2)
+        self.compat._patch_te_expert_parameters(LocalColumnLinear, 'column')
+        module = LocalColumnLinear(config, is_expert=True, stride=2)
+        for param in module.parameters():
+            self.assertIs(param.tensor_model_parallel, True)
+            self.assertIs(param.allreduce, False)
+            self.assertEqual(param.partition_dim, 0)
+            self.assertEqual(param.partition_stride, 2)
+
+    def test_etp_shards_and_row_bias_have_correct_clipping_norm(self):
+        from megatron.core import tensor_parallel
+
+        predicate = tensor_parallel.param_is_not_tensor_parallel_duplicate
+        for tp, ep, etp in ((2, 1, 2), (4, 1, 2), (2, 2, 2)):
+            with self.subTest(tp=tp, ep=ep, etp=etp):
+                modules = []
+                for rank, grad in enumerate((3., 4.)):
+                    module = torch.nn.Module()
+                    module.weight0 = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(1))
+                    module.weight0.grad = torch.tensor([grad])
+                    module.bias0 = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(1))
+                    module.bias0.grad = torch.tensor([5.])
+                    self.compat._set_expert_parameter_attributes(module, 'row', ep > 1 or etp != tp)
+                    modules.append(module)
+                selected = [
+                    param.grad for rank, module in enumerate(modules) for param in module.parameters()
+                    if predicate(param, tp_group=RankGroup(rank), expert_tp_group=RankGroup(rank))
+                ]
+                # Independent oracle: both weight shards and exactly one replicated bias.
+                norm = torch.stack([grad.square().sum() for grad in selected]).sum().sqrt()
+                self.assertAlmostEqual(norm.item(), 50.**0.5, places=6)
+                for module in modules:
+                    for param in module.parameters():
+                        param.grad.mul_(1. / (norm + 1e-6))
+                actual_squared = sum(module.weight0.grad.square().sum() for module in modules)
+                actual_squared += modules[0].bias0.grad.square().sum()
+                self.assertAlmostEqual(actual_squared.sqrt().item(), 1., places=6)
+
+    def test_ep_one_still_uses_expert_topology_when_etp_differs(self):
+        from megatron.core.tensor_parallel.layers import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
+        from megatron.core.transformer.moe.moe_layer import MoELayer
+
+        config = SimpleNamespace(
+            expert_model_parallel_size=1, tensor_model_parallel_size=2, expert_tensor_parallel_size=1)
+        modules = []
+        for cls in (ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear):
+            module = cls.__new__(cls)
+            torch.nn.Module.__init__(module)
+            module.config = config
+            module.is_expert = True
+            module.register_parameter('weight', torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(2, 2)))
+            module.register_parameter('bias', torch.nn.Parameter(torch.empty(2)))
+            module.weight.tensor_model_parallel = True
+            module.weight.partition_dim = 0 if cls is ColumnParallelLinear else 1
+            module.bias.tensor_model_parallel = False
+            modules.append(module)
+        with patch.object(self.compat, '_legacy_expert_topology', return_value=True):
+            moe = MoELayer.__new__(MoELayer)
+            torch.nn.Module.__init__(moe)
+            moe.config = config
+            moe.experts = torch.nn.ModuleList(modules)
+            self.compat.prepare_expert_parallel_parameters(moe)
+        column, row = modules
+        self.assertIs(column.weight.allreduce, False)
+        self.assertIs(row.weight.allreduce, False)
+        self.assertIs(column.bias.tensor_model_parallel, False)
+        self.assertIs(row.bias.tensor_model_parallel, False)
+        self.assertIs(column.weight.tensor_model_parallel, True)
+        self.assertIs(row.weight.tensor_model_parallel, True)
+        self.assertEqual(column.weight.partition_dim, 0)
+        self.assertEqual(row.weight.partition_dim, 1)
+
+    def test_expert_containers_without_backend_specific_flags(self):
+        from megatron.core.transformer.moe.experts import GroupedMLP, SequentialMLP, TEGroupedMLP
+        from megatron.core.transformer.moe.moe_layer import MoELayer
+
+        for expert_type in (TEGroupedMLP, SequentialMLP, GroupedMLP):
+            for tp, ep, etp in ((1, 1, 1), (2, 1, 1), (2, 2, 1)):
+                with self.subTest(expert_type=expert_type.__name__, tp=tp, ep=ep, etp=etp):
+                    # Parameter ownership, not a GPU/NPU linear's optional is_expert flag,
+                    # determines its process group. No device kernels are needed here.
+                    experts = expert_type.__new__(expert_type)
+                    torch.nn.Module.__init__(experts)
+                    experts.register_parameter('weight0', torch.nn.Parameter(torch.ones(2)))
+                    experts.weight0.allreduce = True
+                    experts.weight0.tensor_model_parallel = False
+                    experts.adapter = torch.nn.Linear(2, 2, bias=False)
+                    experts.adapter.weight.allreduce = False
+                    moe = MoELayer.__new__(MoELayer)
+                    torch.nn.Module.__init__(moe)
+                    moe.config = SimpleNamespace(
+                        tensor_model_parallel_size=tp, expert_model_parallel_size=ep, expert_tensor_parallel_size=etp)
+                    moe.experts = experts
+                    moe.router = torch.nn.Linear(2, 2)
+                    moe.shared_experts = torch.nn.Linear(2, 2)
+                    for p in (*moe.router.parameters(), *moe.shared_experts.parameters()):
+                        p.allreduce = True
+                    self.compat.prepare_expert_parallel_parameters(moe)
